description_en: Modifies information about a host. The information includes the address, name, and description of the host and the operating system that the host runs
description_zh: 支持修改主机的地址、名称、操作系统类型和备注信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHost

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to modify the information about the host.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to modify the information about the host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的主机所在堡垒机的区域ID。
Region ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query the ID of the host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

parameters.help_en: The new internal endpoint of the host. You can set this parameter to a domain name or an IP address
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后主机的私网地址，可使用域名或IP地址
parameters.name: host_private_address

parameters.help_en: The new public endpoint of the host. You can set this parameter to a domain name or an IP address
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后主机的公网地址，可使用域名或IP地址
parameters.name: host_public_address

parameters.help_en:
The new operating system of the host. Valid values:

Linux

Windows
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后主机的操作系统类型。取值：
Linux
Windows
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en: The new name of the host. The name can be up to 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后主机的名称，最多支持128字符
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en: The new description of the host. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后主机的备注信息，最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the new network domain to which the host belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html operation to query the network domain ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后主机所属的网络域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The preferred key exchange algorithm of the host. If you set OSType to Linux, you can modify this parameter. Valid values:

default

diffie-hellman-group1-sha1

diffie-hellman-group14-sha1

diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1
parameters.help_zh:
主机首选密钥交换算法配置。当OSType取值为Linux时，可以修改本参数。取值： 

default：默认模式
diffie-hellman-group1-sha1：diffie-hellman-group1-sha1算法兼容模式
diffie-hellman-group14-sha1：diffie-hellman-group14-sha1算法兼容模式
diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1：diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1算法兼容模式
parameters.name: pref_kex

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
